groupPage.metaDescription: Fixed-date seats WAAFA holds with airlines, per adult and indicative until confirmed with you. Request a fare and pay only after you agree.
groupPage.title: Fixed-date seats from Dhaka
groupPage.lead: We hold these seats with airlines in advance. If one matches your date, it is the simplest fare to book. Prices are per adult and indicative until we confirm with you.
groupPage.how1Title: Pick a fare on your date
groupPage.how2Title: Send names as in each passport
groupPage.how3Body: Bank, bKash, Nagad or at our office
groupPage.emptyBody: New fixed-date seats are added every week. Tell us your route and date and we’ll check fares for you.
groupPage.emptyAction: Ask an expert for a fare
groupPage.about: About group fares. Seats are limited and the airline sets the rules: names usually can’t be changed after ticketing, and most of these fares can’t be refunded. We explain the rules for your fare before you pay.
